# cycle_gateway_service (Resource)

Manages the gateway service for a Cycle environment. The gateway is an environment singleton — it always exists and has no create or delete HTTP resource. Create and update send a `reconfigure` job. There is no dedicated GET endpoint; Terraform reads `services.gateway` from `GET /v1/environments/{id}`.

High availability is not part of the reconfigure job body; it is computed from the environment. **Destroy is a state-only no-op.** Removing this resource from Terraform does not disable or reconfigure the Cycle gateway service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The gateway is an environment singleton. This resource reconfigures the
# service that already exists on the environment.
# Destroy only drops Terraform state; the Cycle gateway service remains.
resource "cycle_gateway_service" "api" {
  environment_id = cycle_environment.api.id
  auto_update    = true

  config = jsonencode({
    ipv4        = true
    ipv6        = false
    performance = false
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment whose gateway service is managed. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether the gateway service container is set to auto-update.
- `config` (String) Gateway configuration as a JSON object (`GatewayConfig`). Fields: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, and `performance` (all booleans).

### Read-Only

- `container_id` (String) The ID of the gateway service container, if one has been provisioned.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the gateway service is currently enabled.
- `high_availability` (Boolean) Whether the gateway service is running in high availability mode. This value is read-only; the reconfigure job does not accept it.
- `id` (String) The environment ID this gateway service belongs to. The service is a singleton keyed on `environment_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The gateway service is imported using the environment ID.
terraform import cycle_gateway_service.api 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21
```
